Inputs are document mouse events at ticks; aims resolve to a fraction of a semantic panel's top. Tick 1: pull toward the approach's own top just left of the player, released at the bounce (tick 44): the player leaves the ledge moving left and falls into the purple zone. Tick 545-565: a press inside the zone (aimed at NG3) that must stay blocked. Tick 850: a fresh press after exit grapples the exit ledge and pulls the player onto its top.
